_readme: Auralis in-app copy. Edit this file in GitHub and the app picks it up on next launch (cached, so allow a minute). Every value here is a public claim you are making: App Store guideline 2.3.1 requires in-app claims to be accurate, and showing an App Store rating or user count that does not exist is what gets apps removed. Leave a field as an empty string to hide that element entirely.

socialProof._ratingHelp: Turn on only once your App Store product page actually shows a rating. ratingCaption defaults to 'App Store rating' — use something like 'Rated by our early testers' if the number is not from the App Store.
socialProof._countHelp: Numbers you can back with a screenshot from App Store Connect or your analytics. Empty string hides the element.
socialProof._tickerHelp: The 'N people started in the last hour' ticker counts up on a timer; it is not real data. Keep false unless you wire it to a real source.
socialProof._testimonialHelp: testimonialsIllustrative adds a visible 'Illustrative example' badge. Set false only for quotes from real, consenting users.
